author: InJoseWeTrust
quote: Good mechanics means nothing when you forget your player base and what they want from a GTA title, since 2020 all new stuff in GTA V and now the GTA VI is very far from the people playing it. You now have a story that is way more boring than GTA SA or GTA IV. I felt like I was playing Sims 4 with guns. If we wanted stupid Netflix characters like stuff we wouldn't play GTA theres lots of options on that. If it was a new franchise and not a GTA game no one would be angry. But you guys changd Grand Theft Auto to Take-care-of-a-woman simulator, which is meh. And the woman character in the question ghosts, cheats, hurtful to their kid, which doesn't make sense to me on why these characters are still together.
